security_audit.summary: The four shell execution detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, and the hardcoded URL is a documentation link. The documented jsQRUrl option permits remote decoder loading, creating a supply-chain risk if an untrusted URL is used. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The documented jsQRUrl option can select a remote decoder source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin jsQR to a trusted, versioned source with integrity verification, and reject unapproved jsQRUrl values.

content.user_title: Build a React QR Code Scanner
content.value_statement: Camera-based QR scanning requires coordinated camera controls, decoding state, history, and error handling. This skill provides a React hook contract and an implementation pattern for a usable scanner interface.
actual_capabilities: Defines TypeScript types for QR results, scanner configuration, camera state, and scanner actions.
Shows how to attach video and canvas refs for camera preview and QR processing.
Configures camera facing mode, scan interval, and retained result count.
Demonstrates start, stop, camera switch, and result clearing controls.
Renders timestamped scan results and camera error messages.
Handles unsupported cameras, loading states, and disabled controls.
limitations: Requires the Caffeine AI QR code and camera packages.
Works only where browser camera APIs and camera permissions are available.
The prefabricated scanner hook cannot be modified through this skill.
The jsQR decoder may load from a CDN, so scanner startup can require network access.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Scanning
use_cases.description: Create a React scanner that captures QR identifiers and displays recent results.

use_cases.title: Support Mobile Camera Switching
use_cases.description: Build a mobile scanner with rear-camera defaults, camera switching, and clear control states.

use_cases.title: Add Check-In Scanning
use_cases.description: Integrate QR capture into an attendance workflow while handling permissions and scanner errors.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Scanner
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a React QR scanner using useQRScanner. Include video and canvas refs, start and stop buttons, and a simple results list.

prompt_templates.title: Add Mobile Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a responsive mobile QR scanner. Add permission errors, loading states, camera switching, clear history, and disabled control states.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Integrate QR scanning into [workflow]. Validate decoded values, retain [count] results, and stop the camera after a successful scan.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design QR scanning for [application]. Cover decoder source policy, privacy, accessibility, lifecycle cleanup, performance tuning, and browser fallback behavior.

output_examples.input: Create a basic scanner for a React inventory page.
output_examples.output: A scanner view with explicit start and stop controls, a live camera preview, and timestamped scan results.

output_examples.input: Make the scanner suitable for mobile check-in.
output_examples.output: A responsive check-in scanner with rear-camera startup, camera switching, permission feedback, and a clear recent-results list.

output_examples.input: Improve scanner reliability for a production application.
output_examples.output: A production plan covering trusted decoder loading, scan timing, error recovery, camera cleanup, accessibility, and unsupported-browser behavior.

best_practices: Start the camera only after explicit user action, and stop it when scanning ends or the component unmounts.
Treat decoded QR contents as untrusted input before navigation, storage, or workflow actions.
Test permission denial, unsupported browsers, mobile camera switching, and repeated scan handling.
anti_patterns: Do not automatically open URLs or execute actions from decoded QR contents.
Do not leave the camera active after the scanner is hidden or the workflow completes.
Do not load the decoder from an untrusted or unversioned remote source.

faq.question: Does this skill create QR codes?
faq.answer: No. It documents camera-based QR scanning and decoding.

faq.question: Which React packages are required?
faq.answer: The skill targets the Caffeine AI QR code and camera packages.

faq.question: Can users switch between cameras?
faq.answer: The hook exposes a switch action, but behavior depends on available cameras and browser support.

faq.question: Can I control scanning frequency?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure scanInterval in milliseconds and balance responsiveness against device workload.

faq.question: Does scanning require network access?
faq.answer: The decoder may load from a CDN. Use only trusted decoder sources approved for your application.

faq.question: How should camera errors be handled?
faq.answer: Display the hook error, keep controls disabled during loading, and offer retry behavior when appropriate.
